messages:
ariane: Heads-up — follow-up from last night's token validation incident. Root cause looks like a regression in the token parsing lib that accepted an old-format token after rotation. We need clear owners and deadlines for the postmortem action items.

sam: Agreed. TL;DR symptoms: some services allowed stale tokens for ~23 minutes, caused elevated error rates in auth-checks and a downstream cache miss storm.

devon: Can we add the incident timeline briefly? I pushed a patch earlier but didn't include the validation flag in the new build. See incident ticket RI-3984.

keira: I can own the validation library fix and release. ETA: EOD tomorrow to have a backed-out-safe patch and canary.

sam: Assigning keira -> RI-3992. Action: add strict format validation + unit tests for old/new token variants.

ariane: @keira add integration test that simulates rotation window and asserts reject of pre-rotation tokens once rotation completes. Also: add audit log event 'token.rejected.post_rotation'.

keira: On it. Question: should audit event include the token's rotation id? I can add field rotation_id in audit blob.

devon: yes include rotation_id and service_id. We'll need to update datastores that index audit logs (es/clickhouse) schema change — tagging devon as owner for the logs migration. ETA 1 week.

sam: Action list summary:
- keira: validation lib fix + integ tests + canary (EOD tomorrow)
- devon: audit-schema migration + ingestion tests (1 week)
- ariane: add monitoring alert for 'unexpected accepted token' metric
- ops-bot: schedule follow-up checkin in 3 days

ops-bot: Reminder set: incident follow-up check-in in 72h (thread RI-3992)

keira: I'll include a quick rollback plan in the PR, and a smoke test script: 
```
# smoke test
rotate_tokens --simulate
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <old-token>" https://auth.internal/validate | grep "rejected"
```

sam: Also proposing a recurring runbook item: monthly token rotation validation sweep. If we automate, add to cadence with telemetry (ri-runbook#rotations).

ariane: Good call. Also, let's add a postmortem artifact: a short blameless timeline + improvement list to incident doc. I'll own that writeup. ETA: 48h.

devon: Final ask: gating in CI so rotation tests run on deploys touching auth code. I can add a job to the pipeline. ETA 5 days.

keira: OK. I'll open PRs and link them to RI-3992 & RI-3984. Thanks all.

sam: Thanks — we'll reopen if anything unexpected pops. :thumbsup:
